《巴宰語詞典》p.237，punu 條下派生詞

senses.en: the part of a trap, a very small piece of wood which is hooked at dikit and lamatat, and which is connected by a string to an erected bambo stick, or flexible piece of wood.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.237，punus- 條下派生詞

records.text: xumak a kinixidan ka nahada pungu kahuy

senses.en: Nearby a house there was a tree.

senses.zh: （樹砍倒後殘留地上的）樹樁，樹根

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.237，pupu 條下派生詞

records.text: mupupu sumay pazay anu di daran a kakanen

senses.en: (They) had made balls of sticky rice to eat on the way.
